accessibility.title: Observe isolated recovery flow
accessibility.description: Backups are exported, encrypted, downloaded, and restored in a disposable isolated environment. Verification then decides whether recovery evidence is published; otherwise the failure is reported and rollback revokes export access while preserving evidence.
